name: Elemental Shard Sample
summary: The Elemental Shard Sample bears markings that may help Lotwil Veriatus investigate the machines in the Burning Steppes. It carries a clue from the Badlands to a scholar's camp east of you.

sections.title: A Marked Shard
sections.body: The initials G.L.A. and a rank mark distinguish the shard from the machines found in the Burning Steppes. The Elemental Shard Sample reaches Lotwil Veriatus at his camp to the east, where the scholar studies elemental sciences. The mark may aid the search for whoever made the machines.

faq.q: What is the Elemental Shard Sample?
faq.answer: It is a shard bearing the initials G.L.A. and a rank marking, taken from a machine in the Burning Steppes.
G.L.A. is imprinted on the elemental shards, but its meaning is not known here.
The machines destroyed in the Burning Steppes bear Rank IV markings, thought to be a low rank.
Lotwil Veriatus, a scholar of some renown in elemental sciences, is meant to examine the sample.
Lotwil Veriatus is stationed at a camp east of you.
The shard's markings may help Lotwil assist in the search concerning the machines in the Burning Steppes.
